Complete structural MP/GEN/zero identities are checked; the declared catalogue and non-axiom zero logical truth additionally need current independent catalogue/schema assurance. All positive native proofs need unchanged C1 and independent B, and original-theory lowering when lemmas are imported. No infinite tiling, fixed translation palette, unrestricted FOL negative or equality of tree/DAG/primitive bounds.

assessment: The new contribution is a qualified growing-obligation interface and checked search certificates in that model, not an advantage over goal-directed proof search. Complete provider contacts, markings and frontier decisions are explicit; the point engine still spends substantial work registering alternatives that the formula-directed control handles compactly.

Finite depth and the declared goal-dependent formula inventory limit both searches. A control negative cannot establish unrestricted first-order nonprovability. The same certified four-lemma bank is shared by both methods, so this experiment does not isolate a lemma-acquisition benefit.

The old Y assertions provide regression and transfer evidence. Changed model, depth and preparation costs prevent an apples-to-old-row timing claim. Receptor-family cluster execution and learning in the growing model remain future work.

cost_notes: The original observer wall time was 149.651970 seconds; the experiment field was 149.437653 seconds. Fresh-child peak RSS was 328,581,120 bytes.

Shared current preparation across fifteen assertions took 57.346300 seconds. Raw catalogue build time was 5.039643 seconds inside that preparation, not a separate additive wall total. Independent generation/schema audits, extension and checkpoint work are included in preparation.

Main native verification used 34 requests, 30 fresh executions and 4 exact within-run memo hits; unique execution time was 51.643483 seconds. Checking and lowering happen after the two-second search windows. Historical donor acquisition (61.111021 seconds) is additional and is not free.

A single shared checkpoint is loaded per case; its cost is recorded once although both lane records reference it. Per-lane factory auditing, tree/decode verification and lemma lowering are retained separately. These nested timers must not be summed as independent walls.

Of the ten point unknowns, eight hit MAX_CANDIDATES, one MAX_WORK and one WALL_SECONDS. Every outcome is retained. The two-second windows are cooperative; validation, cleanup and serialization can exceed them.
findings: All fifteen current catalogues completed. Across the thirty main positions, GCTS returned 5 verified point proofs and 10 resource unknowns. The matched-depth control returned 10 verified proofs and 5 finite-inventory, finite-depth negatives.

The five GCTS successes comprise three former training assertions and two former heldout assertions. No policy is trained here. The control finds every point-positive assertion in this cohort and five further certificates.

For nested-function typing, the actual GCTS tree has twelve coarse lines and lowers to six original lines. The control has four coarse lines and lowers to nine. Minimum coarse tree size does not minimize the later primitive expansion.
